name: aquarium
description: Evidence-gated epic and task delivery with optional Podway v2 execution memory and safe development-tool setup for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Epic delivery, validation, and task workflows.
interface.longDescription: Aquarium provides framework-agnostic development-tool setup, isolated release-candidate QA, optional Podway v2 execution memory, procedure-strengthened single-task delivery, sequential epic orchestration, and cold validation that remediates confirmed gaps in a completed epic.
defaultPrompt: Use $aquarium:epic-handler to deliver one roadmap epic, $aquarium:epic-validator to validate a completed epic, or $aquarium:task-handler for one named task.
Use $aquarium:dev-setup to diagnose and configure development tools for this repository.
